At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. 2 Student Job (f/m/x) - IT Operational Excellence / ITPF Controls (20-25 h/week) 

The IT Operational Excellence department drives standardization, optimization and consolidation on strategic level across the RBI Group wherever appropriate.

 

To further support colleagues on their journey of compliant service management within the IT Process Framework we are looking for motivated students (f/m/x) with strong communication and organizational skills that are available to work 20-25h.

our office hours: Mon-Thu 8 am - 5 pm, Fr 8 am - 2 pm

 

Your mission at RBI :

 

 * Learn and work in an agile environment, contributing to the ongoing evolution of the IT-wide IT Process and IT Controls Framework 

 * Assist in ongoing management activities (e.g., status reporting, monitoring, steering and follow-ups) 

 * Collaborate with different internal stakeholders and support their implementation of IT Process and IT Controls Framework 

 * Conduct quality checks on different levels of IT service-related documentation 

 

Your core competencies :

 

 * You are studying at a university or university of applied sciences - preferably Business Management, Risk Management or similar and have an affinity for IT 

 * You have very good knowledge of German and English, both spoken and written 

 * You are interested in Governance topics 

 * You are proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, SharePoint, especially Excel) 

 * You are communicative and open minded 

 * You have a high level of commitment, self-organization and pro-activeness 

 * You have experience with MS Teams, Jira, Confluence, PowerAutomate, and Power BI (beneficial but not mandatory) 

 

What's in it for you?

 

 * Work & Study: The ability to gain practical experience in an international banking environment while continuing your studies

 * Flexibility: Working hours adaptable to your university schedule and a balance of on-site and home-office days

 * Onboarding: An easy start with a buddy from your team to guide you

 * Community: Internal networking with other students

 * Internationality: Operations in Central and Eastern Europe with English as the corporate language, providing a foundation for an international career

 * Canteen: A wide variety of healthy, tasty, and heavily subsidized meal options

 * Further Benefits: Shopping vouchers from the staff council (e.g., supermarkets), free museum tickets, attractive sports offers, fitness center membership allowance, and a reduced public transport ticket

 * Compensation: An attractive monthly student salary of gross EUR 2.619.73 (based on 38.5 hours per week)
